steps.desc: Wiring. Parameter stays optional at the library boundary so the package compiles standalone; the composition root passes an explicit NAMED value at every construction site, including a named value meaning 'platform behaviour, by choice' so silence and deliberate opt-out are distinguishable. An architecture test asserts no construction site omits it, wrapper constructors included.

steps.desc: Name lookup over an HTTPS carrier behind the async seam. Closes the bootstrap cycle first: the lookup service's own address is configured numerically, or that single host deliberately and documentedly uses the platform mechanism.

steps.desc: Cache: serve-stale-while-revalidating with ONE authority for validity. The time-to-live only schedules a refresh; it never stands between the caller and a usable answer. An entry leaves service only on a positive signal — a successful refresh, a real connection failure against that address, or epoch invalidation.

steps.desc: Key rotation on the existing epoch object and its validity window. Windows overlap during rotation so a rotation never invalidates an in-flight connection; each record carries only its epoch id, never a personal expiry field.

steps.desc: Whole-repository gate: every touched package analyzes clean and its suite passes.

steps.desc: Review pass, one dispatch per ticket, reviewer never the author. Each brief asks for an adversarial delta, not a restatement: name two or three concrete failure modes with inputs and state; check the ticket against the locked decisions it touches; flag any claim with no named verifier; then a final version in which every change traces to a named finding. 'No change needed' plus the list of checks performed is a correct answer.
